name: Akkodis
verdict: Digital engineering brand of The Adecco Group, whose three global businesses are Adecco, Akkodis and LHH. Nothing found.
note: Title sponsor of Akkodis ASP Team, carried in the team's name. The team's presentation page records that AKKA Technologies became the team's title sponsor in 2015; the team site now carries the Akkodis name and links to akkodis.com. No state or state fund is named as an owner on The Adecco Group's pages.
